highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 restores Linux system-font discovery and updates Tizen native builds for GCC 14.2.
highlights_body: Linux NoDependencies deployments can once again resolve installed system fonts, while Tizen packages are built with the toolchain required by Tizen 10.

bullets.detail: Linux NoDependencies deployments can again locate installed system fonts through the system font manager.
Tizen native builds and packages now use the compiler toolchain required for Tizen 10.
